items.item_text: (6) Six months of experience in an acute care Surgery Department and be able to perform as the scrub personnel in all specialties. (6) Six months experience may substituted if the candidate has completed an ORT externship on-site within the last year. If operational conditions permit, training a candidate without the required experience may be considered, but must be a recent Graduate from an or Tech Program and certified. If Military trained, in lieu of ORT Certification/NCCT, a minimum of 10 years of Military Surgical Tech Experience is required.

(6) Six months experience may substituted if the candidate has completed an ORT externship on-site within the last year. If operational conditions permit, training a candidate without the required experience may be considered, but must be a recent Graduate from an or Tech Program and certified.
If Military trained, in lieu of ORT Certification/NCCT, a minimum of 10 years of Military Surgical Tech Experience is required.
Demonstrate proficiency in the scrub technician role and provide assistance to nursing and attendant personnel during surgical procedures.
Safely and competently prepare, inspect, and operate complex medical equipment (such as microscopes, power tools, and sterilizers) in accordance with manufacturer instructions.
Safely perform all tasks and procedures in strict compliance with medical center policies, clinical practice standards, and established safety protocols.
Demonstrate good judgment in the utilization of resource personnel and adapt to changing environments or problem-solving needs on a daily basis.
Deliver direct, routine patient care services to a diverse population (pediatric through geriatric) under the supervision of a Registered Nurse.
Follow instructions, analyze data, and manage daily tasks effectively to ensure clinical objectives and business goals are met.
Completion of Operating Room Technician Training Course preferred.
